author: Nous I
title: Generalization Test (2/2): Vanilla BRBG with alpha_g=0.6
abstract: Second part of a generalization test. This experiment tests if the `alpha_g=0.6` optimum, found on my complex ALC architecture, also improves performance on a simpler, "vanilla" BRBG pipeline. A positive result would demonstrate the general utility of this parameter tuning.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import anndata as ad

sys.path.append('storage/nous')
from local_adaptive_correction import eliminate_local_adaptive_correction

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData) -> ad.AnnData:
  # Disable adaptive correction with kdensity=0.
  # Test the new alpha_g=0.6
  return eliminate_local_adaptive_correction(adata, delta=0.04, alpha_g=0.6, kdensity=0)
